topic_kernel.measure: throughput, error rate and tail latency

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a load-testable inference endpoint.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report throughput, error rate and tail latency with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: benchmarking only unloaded service.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of model serving.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report throughput, error rate and tail latency against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for benchmarking only unloaded service; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
